# conveyor_service_account_token (Ephemeral Resource)

Reveals a service account token's secret. Unlike a regular resource attribute, this value is never written to Terraform state, so it cannot leak through a state file. Terraform re-opens this resource (fetching the secret again) on every `plan` and `apply` where `service_account_id` and `client_id` are known.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `client_id` (String) The client id of the token to reveal, typically `conveyor_service_account_token.<name>.client_id`.
- `service_account_id` (String) The id of the service account this token belongs to.

### Read-Only

- `secret` (String, Sensitive) The token's secret.
